items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] I don't know, but he's from the Third Ward.

ctx.x: He was a man when we were kids.

A young man, not an old man, he was a young man, you know. He was a children. What about Shots, where was he from? Third Ward. Oh, the Third Ward. Shots was born in the Third Ward too, but not where I ran.
I don't know, but he's from the Third Ward.
